featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Santos
featured_reviews.review_text:
Usually studios in Bombay are really not worth reviewing but I shot at Studio 84 recently and it ticked a lot of boxes.
The ceiling height is generous, the wide white wall is a dream to enjoy playing with depth along with the big industrial windows that let the natural light do its thing.
Clean, separate restrooms (always underrated!), and they provide a few light stands which I felt is a thoughtful touch for which I’m sure our lightmen silently thanked you.
The studio boy was kind, welcoming and attentive, which always makes a long day easier.
Parking is pay-and-park that’s slightly pricey, but credit to the owner for flagging that upfront. All in all, a studio that’s well priced, damn cool with its aesthetics and a little bit clever in the details. Can’t wait to come back :)
